Definition: neuter singular nominative or accusative case of G3778; that thing:--here (-unto), it, partly, self(-same), so, that (intent), the same, there(-fore, -unto), this, thus, where(-fore).
BiblicalUsage: This — the word that points at what is nearest. Matthew says all this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, and Jesus says, take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat or drink, and John says, this is the work of God, that ye believe on Him whom He hath sent.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the finger points at the thing itself here: all this, this life, this work — and the work is to believe.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
